title: bomify plugin VerifyAttestationResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout for its "signature verify-attestation" subcommand when — and only when — the envelope is a trusted attestation about the given subject, per plugins/contracts/signing/v1/CONTRACT.md. A failed verification is reported by a non-zero exit instead.

signer.description: A human-readable identity of whoever signed the attestation (a key fingerprint, certificate subject, email address, ...). bomify only logs it.

statement.description: The in-toto statement the envelope signs, exactly as signed, standard base64. bomify checks it is the package's build provenance.
